headword: {応急処置|おうきゅうしょち}

definitions.explanation: Initial care given to an injured or ill person before professional medical treatment is available. Includes basic procedures like treating wounds, performing CPR, or stabilizing injuries.
A temporary solution or measure taken to address a problem until a proper or permanent solution can be implemented.

examples.japanese: {怪我|けが}をした{人|ひと}に{応急処置|おうきゅうしょち}を{施|ほどこ}した。
examples.english: I administered first aid to the injured person.

examples.japanese: {応急処置|おうきゅうしょち}の{方法|ほうほう}を{学|まな}んでおくべきだ。
examples.english: You should learn first aid techniques.

examples.japanese: {救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}が{来|く}るまでの{間|あいだ}、{応急処置|おうきゅうしょち}で{止血|しけつ}した。
examples.english: I stopped the bleeding with first aid until the ambulance arrived.

examples.japanese: これは{応急処置|おうきゅうしょち}に{過|す}ぎない。{根本的|こんぽんてき}な{解決|かいけつ}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: This is just a stopgap measure. A fundamental solution is needed.

examples.japanese: {雨漏|あまも}りを{応急処置|おうきゅうしょち}でしのいだが、{早|はや}く{修理|しゅうり}を{頼|たの}まなければ。
examples.english: I got by with a temporary fix for the leak, but I need to call for repairs soon.

examples.japanese: サーバーが{落|お}ちたので{応急処置|おうきゅうしょち}で{再起動|さいきどう}したが、{原因|げんいん}の{調査|ちょうさ}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: The server went down so I restarted it as a temporary fix, but the cause needs to be investigated.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
・{応急|おうきゅう} (emergency) + {処置|しょち} (treatment/measure)

FIRST AID PROCEDURES:
・{止血|しけつ} (stopping bleeding)
・{心肺蘇生|しんぱいそせい}/CPR (cardiopulmonary resuscitation)
・AED{使用|しよう} (AED use)
・{包帯|ほうたい}を{巻|ま}く (bandaging)
・{骨折|こっせつ}の{固定|こてい} (immobilizing fractures)

RELATED TERMS:
・{救急箱|きゅうきゅうばこ} (first aid kit)
・{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ} (ambulance)
・{救命講習|きゅうめいこうしゅう} (lifesaving course)
・{応急手当|おうきゅうてあて} (emergency care - synonym)

IN JAPAN: Many schools and workplaces offer {普通救命講習|ふつうきゅうめいこうしゅう} (standard lifesaving courses) that teach {応急処置|おうきゅうしょち} including CPR and AED use. Public AEDs are widely available in train stations, schools, and public buildings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{応急処置|おうきゅうしょち}を{施|ほどこ}す (to administer first aid)
・{応急処置|おうきゅうしょち}を{学|まな}ぶ (to learn first aid)
